solutions.title: Try every start
solutions.strategy: For each start index, extend right until the target sum is reached or the array ends.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each start index may scan the remaining suffix.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the running sum and best length are stored.

solutions.title: Positive-number sliding window
solutions.strategy: Expand right to reach the target, then shrink left while the target still holds.

timeComplexity.explanation: Both left and right pointers move forward at most n times.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only pointers, running sum, and best length are stored.
